Class RestaurantResource

java.lang.Object
lt.viko.eif.dalencinovic.rest.resource.RestaurantResource
@Component @Path("/restaurants") @Produces({"application/json","application/xml"}) @Consumes("application/json") public class RestaurantResource extends Object
REST resource class responsible for restaurant operations. Provides CRUD operations, filtering, headers, forms, and matrix parameter examples.
